_: GlobalVariable (GLOB) demo. A GLOB is one named number shared across the whole game, persisted in the save and readable by CONDITIONS with zero Papyrus (GetGlobalValue), by Papyrus (GetValue/SetValue), and the console (set/show). Three subtypes: short | long (int) | float. Use as a FLAG / re-arm token (0/1), a COUNTER, a chance/weight, or a tuning CONSTANT. The plugin value is the INITIAL value only — an existing save keeps its own runtime value (new game picks up the new initial). This spec declares one of each type plus a constant, then proves the canonical use: a dialogue line gated on a flag global (the NPC only offers the line while MF_SeenIntro == 0). To FLIP the flag at runtime you'd SetValue it from a result script / quest fragment / alias script (not shown here — this slice is the GLOB record + reference).
